name: Breeze Canna | 2g PRO Disposable | Cherry Lemon Mango
description: Take a tropical vacation with this exotic fusion of juicy cherries, tangy lemons, and ripe mangoes. Enhanced with limonene, myrcene, and alpha pinene terpenes, this vibrant blend brings energetic, relaxed, and happy feelings that make every day feel like a beach day. It's your ticket to instant tropical bliss.
